verses.english: The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: Because of developing and cultivating these five faculties, one of two results can be expected:

verses.pali: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
verses.english: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
